purpose: Auditable Stable/main source reconciliation before Arthur v0.1.6 file-management changes.

classification_policy.PROTECTED_PRODUCT_PAYLOAD: Configuration, overlays, package recipes, patches, source locks, build defaults, and source/package selection scripts use the exact real-device-confirmed Stable tree.
classification_policy.CONTROL_PLANE_ONLY: Current main orchestration, release state, policy, and gate implementation are retained where they do not select product payload.
classification_policy.TEST_ONLY: Current main tests are retained as verification inputs except tests tied only to unproven product additions, which are reviewed against the Stable implementation.
classification_policy.DOC_ONLY: Current main documentation and contracts are retained.
classification_policy.OBSOLETE: Generated build output tracked by Stable but removed by current main remains deleted.
classification_policy.FILE_MANAGEMENT_V016: Applied after the reconciliation baseline only, using the exact already live-validated package implementation.

protected_domain_comparison.source_locks: Use Stable locks; add only LinkEase versions/refs/runtime hashes from the frozen APK provenance.
protected_domain_comparison.required_plugins: Stable and current main are byte-identical; all 22 remain enabled.
protected_domain_comparison.LAN_Wi-Fi_root_defaults: Use Stable build.env and first-boot overlay; no value changes.
protected_domain_comparison.OpenClash_AdGuardHome_DNS: Use Stable config, package inputs, runtime overlays and patches. Stable-to-live-evidence differences are reviewed separately by the formal PREBUILD binder.
protected_domain_comparison.QuickStart_QuickFile: Use Stable QuickStart source/payload and add the four exact LinkEase packages plus QuickFile persistence.
protected_domain_comparison.themes: Use Stable theme configuration and locks.
protected_domain_comparison.package_source_behavior: Use Stable add-custom/build source integration plus only the frozen LinkEase additions.
